name: alternate-dumbbell-reverse-fly-on-incline-bench.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the exercise by setting an adjustable back bench to an angle of around 30-40 degrees.
2. Grab a pair of dumbbells and position yourself with your chest on the back of the bench (prone position).
3. Plant your feet on the floor for stability and hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip.
4. Take a deep breath and pull one dumbbell towards the ceiling using the rear deltoids.
5. Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position and immediately repeat the movement on the other arm. This is one rep.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
